name: Dishman Hills main parking off Sargent Rd, just south of Appleway Blvd
basis: Dishman 'Getting There' text: 'Land managers have asked that climbers park at the main Dishman Hills Natural Area parking (8590 E Appleway Blvd). PLEASE do not park at the pull-out/gate just off of Appleway as this directly threatens climbing access.' Natural Area page: when the Camp Caro upper lot (26 spaces) is closed, visitors use the overflow lot just west of Sargent Road, just south of Appleway. Mapped lot w408787377 (gravel, ~100 cap, free, access yes) sits on that spot (0.06 km from S Sargent Rd per named.mjs, ~0.3 km from Appleway; Main Wall 0.4 km away). Camp Caro upper lot w88436001 (cap 26) is the alternative; chosen the Appleway-side lot as the 'main' parking. Match by position.
